crisis.explanation: 5 social media posts + heavy rainfall alert (42mm/hr) + G-10 Main Boulevard fully blocked with 34 stranded vehicles all point to severe urban flooding in G-10.

actions: Close G-10 Main Boulevard and redirect all traffic
Deploy Rescue Team RES-02 to G-10 immediately
Dispatch Ambulance AMB-07 via G-11 Link Road
Deploy Water Pump Truck PUMP-01 to G-10 drainage point
Station Traffic Police POLICE-G10 at G-10 entry points

alerts.message: EMERGENCY ALERT: Severe flooding in G-10 Islamabad. Avoid G-10 Main Boulevard. Use Islamabad Expressway or G-11 Link Road as alternate routes. Emergency services deployed.
ZARURI ITLAA: G-10 Islamabad mein shadeed saili. G-10 Main Boulevard se bachein. Islamabad Expressway ya G-11 Link Road use karein. Emergency services aa rahi hain.
ROAD CLOSED: G-10 Main Boulevard. Use alternate routes.

outcome.summary: Emergency response successfully initiated for Urban Flooding in G-10, Islamabad. 6 units deployed with first responder ETA of 3 minutes. Traffic congestion reduced from 53% to 24% through alternate route activation. Public alerts dispatched to over 21,000 residents.
